image_description: A vintage blue typewriter viewed from a high angle. The image features a full keyboard with round, white keys bearing black characters. A sheet of white paper is loaded into the platen at the top, and a light blue document rests on the left side tray. The central focus for evaluation is the long, rectangular key at the bottom center of the keyboard.
